fields.System.Title: RPL-402 — Replenish ahead of a wave
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want pick faces topped up for what a wave will need, so that the
wave completes without pickers hitting empty locations.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given wave demand exceeds current pick face stock, then a replenishment task is
  • created for the shortfall before the wave is released.
  • - Given demand exceeds even the rule maximum, then the task fills to capacity and the
  • remaining shortfall is flagged.
  • - Given an existing open task for that location, then its quantity is increased rather
  • than a second task created.
  • - Given the wave is cancelled before release, then any task created solely for it is
  • cancelled if not yet started.
  • - Given demand-driven and reactive triggers together, then exactly one open task per
  • location exists.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, outbound, inventory |
| Tables | replen_task, demand view |
| Risks | Duplicate tasks from two trigger sources ([doc 09 §7.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); over-replenishing cancelled waves |
| Tests | integration · concurrency |
